members.name: Duarte
members.bio: Mine rescue, Atacama. Walked out of a collapse that kept her brother.

members.name: Kowalczyk
members.bio: Pipeline welder. Talks to valves. The valves listen.

members.name: Adeyemi
members.bio: Navy submariner, retired early. Will not say why.

members.name: Sorensen
members.bio: Seismologist who stopped trusting her own instruments at 3 000 meters.

members.name: Takahara
members.bio: Twenty years on refinery fires. Sleeps fine.

members.name: Ruiz
members.bio: Cook on the last rig that came this way. The last rig is still down here.
